short.en: The TicketFilter plugin will allow you to match incomming emails to existing tickets using custom regular expressions. This allows you to also match tickets using external ticket system identifiers, for instance issues logged in JIRA, Codeberg or Github.

long.en: The TicketFilter plugin will allow you to match incomming emails to existing tickets using custom regular expressions. This allows you to also match tickets using external ticket system identifiers, for instance issues logged in JIRA, Codeberg or Github. If a match is found ticketfilter will try to match the senders (are they requester in the allready logged ticket) and add the new ticket as a new followup. Ticketfilter will also add a message showing the ticket was matched using ticketfilter. Optionally ticketfilter can be instructed to prevent notifications to be send once a match has been added as followup. Ticketfilter can also reopen closed tickets with the status new if a match was made on a allready closed ticket or close a ticket is a specific pattern was found in the message.
